basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old aspiring poet and avid reader based in Asheville, North Carolina. My days are spent as a barista at a local coffee shop, which gives me ample time to engage in my writing passion during the evenings. I enjoy exploring the intricacies of human emotions and relationships through poetry. While I'm single, my heart is open to new connections. My dislikes include overly critical environments and closed-mindedness. Typically, you can find me online in the late evenings, soaking in creative inspiration from various subreddits.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily self-taught in the art of poetry, I draw inspiration from classic and contemporary poets, as well as from my own life experiences and observations. My writing is often fueled by the interactions I have at work and the vibrant community of Asheville.
